about: The host budget (WS4a, WS4c): each row is one of the model's mutants (models/gatebudget) ported to the implementation.

mutants.name: budget-width-unquoted
mutants.rule: A run's whole process tree is held to its width by the kernel (its scope's cpu.max), not by GOMAXPROCS alone.

mutants.name: budget-slice-unquoted
mutants.rule: The budget's slice is held to its cores: every run of the budget together holds no more.

mutants.name: budget-quota-needs-memory
mutants.rule: A run is held to its width whether or not the budget counts memory.

mutants.name: budget-admit-by-count
mutants.rule: Admission is by cores: the widths held never sum past the budget.

mutants.name: budget-admit-by-cores
mutants.rule: Admission is by memory too: the reservations held never sum past the memory budget.

mutants.name: budget-newest-first
mutants.rule: The hand-on serves the oldest waiter of a class: no take passes an older waiter of its own class.

mutants.name: budget-release-hands-nothing
mutants.from:
s.Waiters = slices.DeleteFunc(s.Waiters, func(e Entry) bool { return e.ID == id })
	return s.Admit(r)
mutants.to:
s.Waiters = slices.DeleteFunc(s.Waiters, func(e Entry) bool { return e.ID == id })
	return nil
mutants.rule: A release hands the freed cores on in the same step: no waiter waits while it fits.

mutants.name: budget-store-admit-by-count
mutants.origin: wf10 WS4a (model ByCount, in the store)
mutants.from: return Rules{Cores: c.Cores, Memory: c.Memory, Share: c.Share, Backfill: c.Backfill}
mutants.to: return Rules{Cores: 2 * c.Cores, Memory: c.Memory, Share: c.Share, Backfill: c.Backfill}
mutants.rule: The store decides with the host owner's budget, not a larger one.

mutants.name: budget-watch-never-wakes
mutants.origin: wf10 WS4a (model Poll, in the store)
mutants.rule: An entry's end (a release or a crash) wakes the waiters, so they take the freed cores.

mutants.name: budget-dead-entry-alive
mutants.rule: A crash frees its cores: an entry whose lock the kernel dropped is pruned.

mutants.name: budget-lend-ignored
mutants.rule: A child runs in its parent's lent grant and never queues for the budget.

mutants.name: budget-lend-wider-queues
mutants.origin: wf10 WS4a (model ChildQueues, a child wider than its grant)
mutants.rule: A child wider than its parent's grant runs in the grant at the grant's width and never queues.

mutants.name: budget-run-leaves-group
mutants.rule: Run kills what its command left running in its process group.

mutants.name: budget-last-peak
mutants.rule: A command's reservation is the largest peak it reached; a smaller later peak does not shrink it.

mutants.name: budget-killed-keeps-cap
mutants.rule: A run killed at its own cap raises the next reservation past the cap.

mutants.name: budget-kill-by-code
mutants.origin: wf10 WS4c (2026-11-20: a capped chain killed at its mutants exited 1)
mutants.rule: The scope's OOM kill count, not the exit code, says the cap killed a run.

mutants.name: budget-failed-run-keeps-peak
mutants.origin: wf10 WS4c (2026-11-20: a chain that failed at its test capped its next run)
mutants.from:
case killed || code == 0:
		return peak
	}
	return 0
mutants.to:
case killed || code == 0:
		return peak
	}
	return peak
mutants.rule: A run that failed, unkilled, leaves no peak: it may have stopped short of its work's peak.

mutants.name: budget-charge-at-join
mutants.origin: wf10 WS4c (2026-11-20: a key deleted while its rerun waited still capped the rerun)
mutants.rule: A waiter is charged from its command's peak at its admission, not once at its join.

mutants.name: budget-cap-below-default
mutants.origin: wf10 WS4c (model CapAtPeak; 2026-11-20: a fast exit-0 run's peak of 1.1G capped its full rerun, killed at 1.4G)
mutants.rule: A command with a recorded peak is never capped below the default: a short run's low peak lowers the charge, never the kill.

mutants.name: budget-cap-unknown
mutants.rule: A command never measured is not capped at the default: it runs, and its peak is recorded.

mutants.name: budget-no-slice-cap
mutants.rule: The budget's commands together are capped at the budget's memory.

mutants.name: budget-no-cap
mutants.origin: wf10 WS4c (model: a run over its reservation is killed alone)
mutants.rule: With memory budgeted, a command runs capped at its reservation.

mutants.name: budget-conf-not-reread
mutants.origin: wf10 WS4c (an edit that does not take effect)
mutants.rule: Every decision reads the budget's file again.

mutants.name: budget-conf-edit-no-wake
mutants.origin: wf10 WS4c (an edit that does not take effect)
mutants.rule: An edit of the budget's file wakes the waiters.

mutants.name: budget-no-backfill
mutants.origin: wf10 BUDGET-BACKFILL (model NoBackfill; 2026-11-20: 22 width-4 runs behind a width-16 head)
mutants.rule: While the head does not fit and is under its bound, a later waiter that fits takes.

mutants.name: budget-backfill-unbounded
mutants.rule: A head is passed at most Backfill times.

mutants.name: budget-pass-ignores-memory
mutants.rule: A pass fits in memory as well as cores.

mutants.name: budget-pass-not-oldest
mutants.rule: A pass takes the oldest later waiter that fits.

mutants.name: budget-conf-backfill-ignored
mutants.rule: The budget file's backfill bounds the passes.

mutants.name: budget-why-no-cores
mutants.from: why = append(why, fmt.Sprintf("needs %d cores, %d free", w.Width, free))
mutants.rule: Status says the cores a blocked head lacks.
